what: The 1-D channel model's parameters, fitted to the camera's measurements by tools/camera/vision_channel.py. wavemodel/flow.py and the 3D viewer read this file.
fitted_on: calibration/validation.json: 43 camera runs, fitted through wavemodel/flow.py (commanded motion -> air model -> channel)

held_out_error.how: median over runs of RMS(prediction - measurement) / RMS(measurement), each run predicted by a fit that never saw it

notes.g1-g4, tau1-tau4: gain and delay of each row's flux into the channel (rows 5-6 had no usable runs; rows 7-10 were dry at 406 mm)
notes.L, Re: effective distance (m) and reflection of the far-end echo; the gate is open, so L is beyond the 17.8 m channel
notes.Rh, tau_h: reflection and delay at the head end
notes.log_d0..2: damping rate per metre, d0 + d1 w + d2 w^2
notes.h_scale: effective depth for the wave speed, as a multiple of the marked depth
